description: One page of an account's most recent validated transactions, newest first. When to use: To check what an account did recently (payments sent or received, offers, trust line changes) and whether each transaction succeeded. Prefer another tool: For balances and trust lines, use `/v1/xrpl/account/{address}/summary` or `/v1/xrpl/account/{address}/lines`; for full archival history, use a full-history node or indexer: history depth depends on the serving node and older pages may be slower. Example: xrpl_account_transactions {"address":"rHb9CJAWyB4rj91VRWn96DkukG4bwdtyTh"}

address.description: Valid classic XRPL account address (r..., checksum verified)

limit.description: Transactions per page: an integer from 1 to 50 (default 20)

marker.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's `marker`, for the same address

name: xrpl_account_transactions

age_seconds.description: Age of the data at response time

as_of.description: When the data was read from the ledger

ledger_index.description: Validated ledger the data comes from

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

marker.description: Opaque cursor for the next (older) page (send as `marker`); null on the last page

counterparty.description: The other account, when the transaction names one

currency_ascii.description: Readable text of a 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

delivered.description: Delivered amount, when the transaction reports one

title: Account transactions
